body.objective: Select one complete generic compact Euclidean spectral datum and compute the corresponding background-specific parity-even five-form-factor values, or certify the first exact analytic input still missing.
body.stop_condition: Import the independently frozen affine-family theorem.  Declare one content-addressed compact oriented scalar-flat metric with domains and boundary conditions, normalized primed scalar/vector projectors, determinant phase/contour and reference scale.  Construct the complete primed resolvent or equivalent spectral measure with eigenprojectors needed by the Schur finite traces.  Evaluate the five functions and all contact/local normalization pieces on that datum with exact arithmetic where algebraic and certified interval/error control where analytic or numerical.  Verify scale derivatives, zero-mode deletion, orientation symmetries and degeneration to every available exact holdout.  If no tractable generic datum meets the receiver, prove the first missing resolvent/spectral theorem and file one typed Forge or external-analysis request rather than interpolating special backgrounds.
body.current_gate: first background-specific global spectral realization of the parameterized five form factors
body.forbid: no invented generic spectrum; no heat-kernel asymptotics substituted for finite spectral data; no special S4/S2xS2 interpolation; no floating value without certified error and domain provenance; no universal, QME, Lorentzian, particle or unitarity claim
activates: or an exact global spectral shortfall with a minimal external input contract
body.resource_hint: QUANTUM GLOBAL-SPECTRAL LANE.  Local coefficients are complete; choose and certify the global datum before asking for finite numbers.
notes: A precise no-tractable-datum theorem is acceptable if it names the first missing analytic object and preserves the affine family.
